definitions.explanation: An official or formal statement about facts or events; the act of informing someone about something.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}に{結果|けっか}を{報告|ほうこく}する。
examples.english: To report the results to my boss.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
{報告|ほうこく}によると、{事故|じこ}の{原因|げんいん}は{不明|ふめい}だ。
examples.english: According to the report, the cause of the accident is unknown.

notes:
USAGE: {報告|ほうこく} is commonly used in business and official contexts for formal reporting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{報告|ほうこく}する (to report)
・{報告|ほうこく}を{受|う}ける (to receive a report)
・{報告書|ほうこくしょ} (written report)
・{報告|ほうこく}{会|かい} (report meeting)
・{進捗|しんちょく}{報告|ほうこく} (progress report)
・{中間|ちゅうかん}{報告|ほうこく} (interim report)

BUSINESS NOTE: In Japanese workplaces, ほうれんそう ({報告|ほうこく}・{連絡|れんらく}・{相談|そうだん}) is an important concept emphasizing reporting, communication, and consultation.
